g.text: Purple model names = local RTX 2060 runs. Cell colors always encode accuracy.
Every cell: correct / questions, then percentage. Same overall-score order; 20% uniform guessing.
Six newest categories have eight questions each; one answer moves a score by 12.5 percentage points.
